items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance st off should
 carry the suitable
safety category.
Safety rope with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety helmet and safety harnesses is necessary.

Clean contacts with sandpaper; clean all dust and contamination from
 switch parts. This step is also carried out on the earthing switch.
Smooth the contact surfaces using graphite powder and emery cloth.

Inspect and lubricate all movable joints on the drive rod assemblies.
 During the inspection look for loose fasteners and bent shafts. This step is
 also carried out on the earthing switch.

Check the condition of copper shunts (flexible conductor), check for signs
 of fraying and overheating.

Inspect the stationary contact condition; also check the condition of the
 pressure spring to ensure it is not damaged. The pressure spring must also
 be lubricated (oiled).

Inspect the support insulators for chips, cracks and signs of flashovers.
 Also clean the insulators with cloth, heavy contaminates must be cleaned by
 emery cloth or wire brush. Care must be taken not to damage the porcelain
Clean the inside of the mechanism box with air blower.

After the mechanism box has been cleaned, inspect the auxiliary contacts,
 clean if necessary. Check the terminal strips to ensure there are no loose
 connections.
Check alignment of contact during manual close operation.

Perform a close and open function test, listening for unusual noises
 during the operations, also check that the main contacts close in properly.
